description: This PHP source file defines the 'Drawing' class, providing static utility methods for converting measurement units relevant to spreadsheet graphics, such as pixels, EMU, points, degrees, and image creation from BMP files within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Drawing
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for unit conversions and image handling in the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: pixelsToEMU
methods.description: Converts pixels to EMU (English Metric Units).

methods.name: pixelsToCellDimension
methods.description: Converts pixel measurement to Excel cell width units, using font-specific data if available.

methods.name: cellDimensionToPixels
methods.description: Converts Excel cell width units into pixels, based on font data.

methods.name: degreesToAngle
methods.description: Converts degrees to a scaled angle value.

methods.name: angleToDegrees
methods.description: Converts a scaled angle value back to degrees.

methods.name: imagecreatefrombmp
methods.description: Creates an image resource from a BMP file, deprecated, use native PHP function instead.
